create_schedule_sampler: create a named schedule sampler using create_named_schedule_sampler with uniform or loss-second-moment strategy
sample_timesteps_uniform: sample diffusion timesteps uniformly using UniformSampler and call sample with batch size and device
sample_timesteps_loss_aware: sample diffusion timesteps using LossSecondMomentResampler weighted by historical loss second moments
update_loss_weights: update loss-aware sampler weights by calling update_with_local_losses with timestep and loss tensors
review_schedule_sampler_class: review the ScheduleSampler abstract base class and its weights and sample methods
